findings.evidence: Repository grep finds the specialized theorem only at its declaration and twice in `Representation/Differential.lean:74-75`; the general underlying result `tangentToLeftInvariantDerivation_lie` already exists at `LieEquiv.lean:56`.
findings.fix: Replace this specialized exported helper with a theorem that the inverse model isometry maps `⁅v,w⁆` to the bracket of its images for arbitrary `v w : GroupLieAlgebra I G`; keep any cancellation-only helper private.
findings.issue: `leftInvariantDerivationLinearIsometryEquivModelVectorSpace_symm_apply_lieEquiv_apply` only cancels inputs of the form `eLie D`, leaving no public bracket-preservation theorem for the inverse model isometry on arbitrary tangent Lie-algebra vectors.

summary: The differential API is canonical, but the exported inverse model-transport bridge remains specialized to an implementation case rather than exposing bracket transport.
